question: In 2020, how much of a title did a Netflix account need to watch for Netflix to count it?
answer: Two minutes. From late 2019 Netflix counted any account that watched two minutes as having chosen a title, replacing a rule of 70% of a film or of a single episode. The company said the new count ran about 35% higher on average. A pressed play button became a viewer.
move: Before comparing two counts, check that both count the same thing.
ask: Before comparing two numbers, do I know whether they count the same thing?
trap: Assuming a view means someone watched most of what they started.
reference: Netflix, Fourth Quarter 2019 Letter to Shareholders, 21 January 2020
